description: Airports Outline is a dataset listed in County of Santa Clara open data portal (data.sccgov.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by County of Santa Clara. Polyline feature class outlining the major features contained with significant county airports. THE GIS DATA IS PROVIDED "AS IS". Coverage: Santa Clara County, California. The portal files it under the category Government. Its tags are county of santa clara, sccgov, airportoutline. The table has 4 columns. The portal shows 2026-03-23 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-sccgov-org-portal.
